newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thirty workers trapped in blazing Bangkok building.
newsitem.headline: Thirty workers trapped in blazing Bangkok building.

text.p: Fire broke out on Sunday in a building under construction in central Bangkok, trapping some 30 workers on the top floor, witnesses and police said.
They said rescue operations have begun to airlift them to safety. Police said about 30 fire trucks were still fighting the fire, which broke out in the late morning.
Fresh police reports said two people had died in the fire and their bodies were being retrieved.

Witnesses said they saw four helicopters flying above the building, at least 25 storeys high, from which thick smoke was billowing. They watched as several people were airlifted to safety, while many others stood by on the top floor.
"I am not sure about the number of workers waiting on the top floor but it looked like there were about 30 them," said one witness at the scene.
The building, next to a hotel, has been under construction for some time and notice boards around it indicated it was due to be opened soon.
